And with the global race on innovation, the challenge will compound as models become even more...

items.title: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
items.summary: CVE-2026-88771 lets attackers run commands on NetScaler Gateway before anyone signs in. Patching takes time most teams don't have, so the sign-in decision has to move in front of the vulnerable code.

items.title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots
items.summary: Identity alone doesn't guarantee a bot will behave responsibly. We are introducing a system to continuously evaluate whether Verified bots honor site preferences, like robots.txt and HTTP 429s, ensuring they remain accountable over time.

items.title: A fully programmable secure web gateway
items.summary: Cloudflare Gateway and Data Loss Prevention have inherited the flexibility and power of Cloudflare Workers through our full-stack integration with the Cloudflare Developer platform.

items.title: Deploy with Void
items.summary: Introducing Void: an open-source SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform for building full-stack Vite apps and deploying them to Cloudflare.

items.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI: Making AI discovery better for everyone
items.summary: How Cloudflare and OpenAI are working together to help AI find useful content, keep up with changes, and make fewer wasted requests — making the experience better for users and website owners alike.

items.title: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move
items.summary: When strikes hit Yandex data centers, many assumed Russian bot operations went dark. Cloudflare data reveals that while search crawling stopped, malicious bots simply migrated to other networks.
